# One row = one backtest. Edit freely: # Blank cells use the default shown in the column name.
# universe            : nifty50 | nifty100 | nifty200 | nifty500 | niftymidcap100 |
# entry                : buy only stocks ranked this well or better
# exit                 : sell when the rank is worse than this
# n [default = entry]  : max number of holdings
# min_turnover_cr [5]  : minimum median daily traded value
# stock_sma200 [no]    : yes = only buy/hold a stock while its close is above its own 200-day SMA
# index_sma200 [no]    : yes = only buy while the reference index is above its 200-day SMA
# index [nifty50]      : which index to use for index_sma200 (nifty50 or nifty500)
